'''Brian Kallenbach Big Blue Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Brian Kallenbach]]
* '''Published:''' October 1998 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)|Hoth-L-hothechocommandcenterwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Big Blue Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PJP Big Blue Deck Kallenbach LS 1998.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck was designed for Brian Kallenbach's online Star Wars CCG Palace match with Rebel Base Leader Allen Divers (2-6pm, 10/2/98).''

Intro: This Light Side deck is created to be the match of the old-fashioned Dark Side "Big Blue" decks. The deck strategy is simple. Get large quantities of large starships on the table and pound on things.

It's a blunt deck, to say the least. With Haven and Leia Of Alderaan, you can get a significant deployment reduction on the Mon Calamari Cruisers, as well as the Corvettes. From the word go, deploy Cruisers and Corvettes as fast as possible. The Corvettes are very expensive - that's why there's a large amount of locations in the deck, and not many interrupts.

The deck is simple and fun to play, and is excellent at space defense. Though it's a little weak on the ground, this deck is likely to win a Force drain race, due to the fewer cards needed on the table.
